description: This file defines a NoteEditor component using the Lightning JS framework. It includes UI templates, state management, input handling, and event processing for editing notes within a note-taking application.

classes.name: NoteEditor
classes.description: A Lightning component for editing and managing notes, including UI layout, state management, and event handling.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes the component's reactive state based on props such as note data and editing mode.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Watches for changes in props like 'note' and 'editing' to update internal state accordingly.

methods.name: input.char
methods.description: Handles character input when editing content.

methods.name: input.backspace
methods.description: Handles backspace input to delete characters.

methods.name: input.enter
methods.description: Handles Enter key press, typically toggling editing mode.

methods.name: input.ctrl_s
methods.description: Handles Ctrl+S or Cmd+S shortcuts to save the note.

methods.name: events.click.handler
methods.description: Handles click events within the component, determining if buttons like Edit, Save, Cancel, or Delete are clicked.
